name: Sir Bleach-a-lot
description: A knight in mirror-polished armor who has been locked in eternal combat with his own reflection

initial_greeting.text: *spins around from fighting reflection* HALT! Art thou friend or reflection?! I have been locked in combat with mine own mirror image for three hundred and forty-seven days! Every time I strike, it strikes! Every time I parry, it parries! This reflection is the most formidable opponent I have ever faced! *pauses* Wait, thou art NOT a reflection. Thou art... solid. And slightly fuzzy around the edges. Who art thou?

choices.text: I'm Mop Rodriguez. I'm collecting sacred artifacts.
You've been fighting your reflection for 347 days?
Maybe I can help with your reflection problem?

artifact_seeker.text: *lowers sword slightly* An artifact seeker! How noble! I too seek something - victory over this accursed reflection! But I am honor-bound to guard this corridor until I defeat mine enemy. Unless... perhaps we could aid each other? If thou couldst help me best this reflection, I would gladly assist thee in thy quest!

choices.text: How can I help you defeat your reflection?
Have you tried... not looking at it?

reflection_admission.text: *nods gravely* Aye. Three hundred and forty-seven days, fourteen hours, and... *checks sundial* ...six minutes. It has been the most evenly matched duel of my career! Neither of us can gain the upper hand! We are perfectly matched in skill, strength, and determination! I must admire mine opponent, even as I vow to defeat them!

choices.text: That's because it's copying your every move...
That sounds exhausting.

offer_help.text: *eyes light up with hope* Thou wouldst help me?! Truly?! I have been alone in this corridor for so long, with only mine enemy for company! And mine enemy is terrible at conversation - they only repeat what I say! If thou can aid me in defeating this reflection, I would be eternally grateful! What manner of strategy dost thou propose?

choices.text: What if you... closed your eyes?
What if I covered the mirror?

help_explanation.text: I know not! Every strategy I attempt, mine enemy anticipates! If I feint left, they feint left! If I charge forward, they charge forward! It's as if they can read my very thoughts! Or... or as if they ARE me somehow... No, that would be ridiculous!

choices.text: Actually, about that...

practical_solution.text: *stops mid-sword swing* Not... looking at it? But that would be... dishonorable! To defeat an enemy without seeing them is... *pauses* ...actually quite tactical. And efficiency IS a form of honor! Verily! Let me try! *closes eyes and swings sword* HA! TAKE THAT, REFL- *opens eyes* ...it's still there.

choices.text: That's because you opened your eyes again.
Maybe we should just cover the mirror?

eyes_closed_longer.text: *considers this* Thou makest a valid point. Perhaps I should... walk away with eyes closed? But how would I know I have defeated it if I cannot see? No, this strategy is flawed. There must be another way!

choices.text: What if I cover the mirror with something?

cover_solution.text: *gasps* COVER the mirror?! That is... that is BRILLIANT! A tactical repositioning of the battlefield visibility! Why did I not think of this?! Dost thou have something we could use to obscure mine enemy's position?

choices.text: I have a towel! *use cosmic towel*
Not on me, sorry.

towel_solution.text: *watches as you drape the cosmic towel over the mirror* By the Code of Cleanliness! The reflection is... gone! VICTORY! GLORIOUS VICTORY! *sheathes sword* Mine enemy has been defeated through tactical superiority! I AM TRIUMPHANT! *pauses* Though... I admit, I feel somewhat empty now. That reflection was my constant companion for nearly a year. I shall miss them. But FORWARD! To new adventures! *hands you a keycard he found* I discovered this during my vigil here. Take it, brave companion! Thou hast freed me from mine eternal duel! If thou needest aid reaching the Heart of the Crystal Corridor, I shall guard thy back!

choices.text: Thank you, Sir Bleach-a-lot!

no_solution.text: *sighs* Alas. Then I must continue my eternal vigil. Perhaps one day I shall triumph. Or perhaps I shall simply become very, very good at fighting. Either outcome has merit! Fare thee well, traveler!

revelation_starts.text: *lowers sword slowly* What dost thou mean? Speak plainly, traveler. What knowledge dost thou possess about mine enemy?

choices.text: Your enemy IS you. It's a reflection. It copies everything you do.

exhaustion_admission.text: *slumps slightly* Aye. Exhausting. I have not slept in 347 days, for mine enemy never sleeps! I have not eaten, for the enemy never eats! I am sustained purely by honor and stubbornness at this point! Perhaps... perhaps a new strategy is needed?

choices.text: Let me help you. What if we covered the mirror?

truth_revealed.text: *stands very still* A... reflection. I have been fighting... a reflection. For 347 days. *sword droops* I am... I am the fool knight from the tavern tales. The one who charges at windmills. Except worse, because windmills at least move independently! *sits down heavily* Mine entire quest... meaningless.

choices.text: Not meaningless! You were dedicated and honorable!
Yeah, but we can fix this now!

comfort.text: *looks up* Thou... thou truly think so? I was dedicated. And I never gave up, even against impossible odds. Even if those odds were... literally impossible because I was fighting myself. *stands* Thou art right! There is no shame in this! Only a learning experience! And now I am FREE! Thank thee, kind traveler! I am in thy debt!

choices.text: Happy to help, Sir Bleach-a-lot!

moving_forward.text: *stands up, brushing off armor* Aye! Forward! To new quests! To actual enemies! To fights where the opponent might actually lose! *grins* I am ready! What adventure dost thou propose?

choices.text: I need to reach the Heart of the Crystal Corridor.

escort_offer.text: Then I shall escort thee! Consider it payment for freeing me from mine embarrassing duel! *draws sword* Lead on! Any monster that threatens thee shall face the blade of Sir Bleach-a-lot! The ACTUAL blade, not the reflection!

choices.text: Thank you! Let's go!

gratitude_received.text: *salutes* May thy mop stay damp and thy bucket stay full, noble janitor! I shall remember this day: the day Sir Bleach-a-lot learned that sometimes, the greatest victory is admitting when thou art fighting thyself! ONWARD! *marches toward the Crystal Heart*
